Haryana TET HTET 2026 Notification : Eligibility Details
HTET Level I Class 1-5 PRT Teacher

10+2 Intermediate with 50% Marks and Passed / Appearing 2 Year Diploma in Elementary Education / Special Education / B.E.Ed OR 10+2 Intermediate with 45% Marks and Passed / Appearing 2 Year Diploma in Elementary Education / Special Education / B.E.Ed OR Bachelor Degree in Any Stream  and Passed / Appearing 2 Year Diploma in Elementary Education / Special Education / B.E.Ed .
HTET Level II TGT Teacher Class 6 to 8

Bachelor Degree in Any Stream with 50% Marks and 2 Year Diploma in Education /  Elementary Education OR Bachelor Degree with 50% Marks and B.Ed / Special B.Ed Degree OR 10+2 with 50% Marks and 4 Year BA B.Ed / B.Com B.Ed Degree. For More Details Read Full Notification.
Master Degree in Concerned Subject with 50% Marks and  B.Ed Degree. For Subject Wise Eligibility Details Read the Notification.
